method: numerical search of this atlas (code/cannon_tetra.py from PR #32: start from a cannonball pile with degree continuation, then code/simplex_cubature.py orbit elimination with symmetry groups S and A), checked numerically; the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm under all moment equations with a penalty for nodes outside the domain and the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py)
